newsitem.title: USA: Eskimo Pie stake raised by Gabelli group.
newsitem.headline: Eskimo Pie stake raised by Gabelli group.

text.p: A group led by New York money manager Mario Gabelli said Wednesday it raised its stake in Eskimo Pie Corp to 363,000 common shares or 10.5 percent.

In a filing with the Securities and Exchange Commission, the group said its latest transactions include a net 44,500 shares bought between May 21 and June 2 at prices ranging from $12.25 to $12.4167 per share.
Eskimo, based in Richmond, Va., markets a line of nationally branded frozen novelities under its own Eskimo Pie brand name as well as Welch's through a national territorial licensing system.
